indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX season_kakao_pending_slot_uidx ON competition.season_kakao_pending_applications USING btree (season_id, apply_date, recruit_no, slot_no, source_room_id_hash, source_mode)

constraint.definition: CHECK ((((status = ANY (ARRAY['REJECTED'::competition.season_application_status, 'RESERVE'::competition.season_application_status, 'CONFIRMED'::competition.season_application_status])) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_by_user_account_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['APPLIED'::competition.season_application_status, 'CANCELLED'::competition.season_application_status])) AND (review_note IS NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (reviewed_by_user_account_id IS NULL))))
